name: iMA iStochastic Custom
summary: This EA combines a Moving Average (iMA) trend filter with a Stochastic Oscillator (iStochastic) to generate trade signals. It enters long positions when the price is above the MA and the Stochastic exits oversold territory, and enters shorts when the price is below the MA and the Stochastic exits overbought territory. The strategy aims to capture trend-following entries on momentum reversals within the prevailing trend direction.
summary_zh: 该EA结合移动平均线(iMA)趋势过滤与随机振荡器(iStochastic)来生成交易信号。当价格在均线上方且随机指标从超卖区回升时做多，当价格在均线下方且随机指标从超买区回落时做空。策略旨在捕捉主趋势方向内动量反转的顺势入场机会。
strategy_analysis: 该策略采用双指标组合方法，使用移动平均线作为趋势方向过滤器，随机振荡器作为入场时机触发器。入场条件为：多头需满足价格位于均线之上且随机指标从超卖区域（低于20水平）向上穿越，空头需满足价格位于均线之下且随机指标从超买区域（高于80水平）向下穿越。出场条件通常依赖于随机指标反向交叉或固定止损止盈水平。仓位管理采用固定手数方式，缺乏基于波动率或账户风险百分比的动态仓位调整机制。资金管理方面仅有基本的止损设置，缺少追尾止损、部分平仓或盈亏平衡等高级风险管理功能。整体策略逻辑简单直观，适合趋势明确的市场环境，但在震荡市中容易产生频繁的虚假信号导致连续亏损。
strategy_analysis_en: The strategy employs a dual-indicator combination approach, using a Moving Average as the trend direction filter and the Stochastic Oscillator as the entry timing trigger. Entry conditions require: long positions when price is above the MA and the Stochastic crosses upward from oversold territory (below the 20 level), and short positions when price is below the MA and the Stochastic crosses downward from overbought territory (above the 80 level). Exit conditions typically rely on Stochastic reverse crossovers or fixed stop-loss and take-profit levels. Position sizing uses a fixed lot approach, lacking dynamic lot calculation based on volatility or account risk percentage. Money management is limited to basic stop-loss settings, missing advanced risk management features such as trailing stops, partial closes, or break-even functionality. The overall strategy logic is simple and intuitive, suitable for trending markets, but prone to frequent false signals and consecutive losses in choppy or ranging market conditions.

parameters.name: Stochastic_Slowing
parameters.description: 随机指标慢速平滑周期

pros: 双指标组合有效过滤震荡市中的虚假信号，提高入场质量
策略逻辑清晰易懂，适合初学者理解和参数优化
顺势交易理念合理，在趋势明确的市场中表现较好
pros_en: Dual-indicator combination effectively filters false signals in ranging markets, improving entry quality
Clear and understandable strategy logic, suitable for beginners to comprehend and optimize parameters
Trend-following concept is sound, performing well in clearly trending market conditions
cons: 固定手数缺乏动态仓位管理，无法根据市场波动率自适应调整风险敞口
缺少追尾止损机制，盈利头寸可能在回撤中大幅缩水
在震荡整理行情中频繁产生虚假突破信号导致连续亏损
未设置新K线检查机制，可能在同一根K线上重复开仓
cons_en: Fixed lot sizing lacks dynamic position management, unable to adapt risk exposure based on market volatility
Missing trailing stop mechanism, profitable positions may give back significant gains during retracements
Generates frequent false breakout signals in choppy consolidation markets leading to consecutive losses
No new bar check mechanism, potentially opening duplicate positions on the same candle
improvements: 增加基于ATR的动态止损止盈和追尾止损机制，提升风险管理能力
添加新K线检查和仓位检查逻辑，防止重复开仓和过度暴露风险
引入多时间周期确认机制，例如在H4级别确认趋势后在H1级别寻找入场点
improvements_en: Add ATR-based dynamic stop-loss, take-profit, and trailing stop mechanisms to enhance risk management
Implement new bar check and position check logic to prevent duplicate entries and overexposure
Introduce multi-timeframe confirmation, e.g., confirming trend on H4 before seeking entries on H1

risk_points: 固定手数不根据账户余额和波动率调整，大行情时风险敞口可能过大
缺少新K线检查机制，存在同根K线重复开仓的风险
止损止盈可能默认为零，存在无止损无限亏损的可能
risk_points_en: Fixed lot size does not adjust for account balance and volatility, potentially creating excessive risk exposure during large moves
Missing new bar check mechanism creates risk of duplicate position opening on the same candle
Stop-loss and take-profit may default to zero, creating potential for unlimited losses without protection
